regional_summary_6h.headline: Israeli strikes hit Syria after Turkey 'red line' warning; US vows to collapse Iran
bullets: Israeli strikes targeted Syria and southern Lebanon following an Israeli envoy's claim that Turkey crossed a red line in Syria.
The US vowed to 'collapse' Iran with new sanctions as energy prices spiked, while Washington designated Hezbollah as an Iranian-commanded group.
Syrian Kurdish leadership declared integration with Damascus complete amid civil society debates over the post-Assad political order.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Monitor Turkish military response to Israeli strikes and Iranian reaction to US collapse vow.
